Tour de Coler

Bentonville, AR · Coler Mountain Bike Preserve · Mountain bike

No-dropBeginner friendly

Tour de Coler is a mountain bike group ride in Bentonville, AR. Schedule: Every Tuesday evening, from The Grove parking lot, Coler Mountain Bike Preserve. Pace: all skill levels. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: all skill levels. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Tour de Coler group ride

A free weekly mountain bike group ride at Coler, run by the foundation that manages the preserve. All skill levels, meeting at The Grove parking lot. Check the Coler events page for the time.
